messages.Язык интерфейса. Тексты объявлений, пере: Interface language. Listings, conversations, contracts and some help text are currently available in Russian.

messages.Изменения применяются к будущим договора: Changes apply to future contracts. Signed copies keep their original details.
messages.Ровно 4 заглавные латинские буквы. Подпи: Exactly 4 uppercase Latin letters. Signed contracts keep their original signature.
messages.Сохраните прогресс в файл, чтобы перенес: Save a progress file to move the game or restore it after clearing browser data. It includes your nickname, signature, money, cars, orders and contracts.
messages.Заменить текущий прогресс этой копией: Replace current progress with this backup
messages.Удалит деньги, автомобили, долги, перепи: Deletes money, cars, debts, chats, meetings and contracts. A new game starts with ₽100,000. Your nickname, signature, appearance and music preference are kept.
messages.Торгуйся с продавцами и покупателями в ж: Negotiate with sellers and buyers in live chat.
Select a day to view meetings.
messages.1 секунда = 1 игровая минута · в активно: 1 second = 1 game minute · 2 minutes while the clock window is active
messages.Риски покупки на авторынке: Risks of buying on the market
messages.Тащи иконки мышкой · клик открывает · ок: Drag icons to move them · click to open · drag title bars to move windows
messages.Мы обновляем игру. Для лучшей работы обн: The game has been updated. You can start fresh for the best update experience or keep your current progress.
messages.При сбросе удалятся деньги, машины, сдел: Resetting deletes money, cars, deals, loans, notes and contracts. A new game starts with ₽100,000.
messages.Сброс начнёт новую игру и удалит текущий: Resetting starts a new game and deletes current progress. Choose Continue to keep it.
messages.Это игра про перекупа: ищите автомобили,: Find cars, negotiate with sellers and resell for profit. Start with ₽100,000 and gradually build your own business.
messages.Сначала создадим ваш профиль, затем пока: First, create your profile. Then we will walk you through your first deal.
messages.Ник будет указан в договорах купли-прода: Your nickname appears on sale agreements. Choose a signature of four uppercase Latin letters to sign your contracts.
messages.Ровно 4 заглавные латинские буквы, напри: Exactly 4 uppercase Latin letters, such as MIKE. You can change your nickname and signature in Settings.
messages.Указать покупателям все известные недост: Disclose all known faults to buyers. Hiding discovered defects hurts your reputation and may lead to a claim.
messages.Покупатели могут предложить свою цену. Н: Buyers may make counteroffers. A markup above ₽500,000 over the purchase price reduces interest.
messages.Игра запускается на весь экран. Выбранны: The game opens fullscreen. Your chosen format keeps its aspect ratio and does not change the Windows display resolution.
messages.Перед знакомством и обучением выберите р: Choose a game resolution before profile setup and the tutorial. Your monitor size is used by default.
messages.Приложение запускается на весь экран. Из: The app opens fullscreen. The image fits without stretching; a different aspect ratio may leave borders. You can change this later.
messages.Текущий прогресс будет сохранён перед за: Your progress will be saved before the app closes.
messages.Защищённая копия прогресса в формате .pk: Protected progress backup in .pksave format. Files are verified before restoration. Keep the entire game folder together with your wallpapers.
messages.Восстановить эту копию и заменить текущи: Restore this backup and replace your current progress?
messages.Загрузка своих обоев доступна в приложен: Custom wallpaper uploads are available in the Windows app.
messages.Эта настройка доступна в приложении для: This setting is available in the Windows app.
Choose an image up to 20 MB.
PNG, JPG and WebP are supported.
messages.Изображение слишком большое: максимум 36: The image is too large: maximum 36 megapixels.
messages.Приложение не ответило. Попробуйте ещё р: The app did not respond. Please try again.
messages.Выберите защищённую копию .pksave. Откры: Choose a protected .pksave backup. Plain JSON is no longer accepted.
messages.Поле змейки. Стрелки или WASD для управл: Snake board. Use arrow keys or WASD to move; Space to pause.
messages.Стрелки / WASD · Пробел — пауза. При пер: Arrows / WASD · Space to pause. Switching apps pauses the game.
messages.Здравствуйте! Машина ещё продаётся?: Hello! Is the car still available?
messages.Да. Что хотите узнать?: Yes. What would you like to know?
messages.Не опоздайте на встречу: Be on time for the meeting
messages.Все приложения живут в Perekyp OS. Внизу: All apps live in Perekyp OS. The dock holds the market, garage, calendar, calculator, clock and settings. Press P to see all apps.
messages.Обучение можно пропустить и пройти снова: You can skip the tutorial and replay it from Help.
messages.На авторынке выберите город, найдите мар: Choose a city on the market, search for a make or model, and use the filters. Compare price, mileage and condition. The heart saves a listing to Favorites.
messages.У вас 100 000 ₽ на старте. Оставляйте за: You start with ₽100,000. Keep some money for inspections, travel and possible repairs.
messages.Нажмите «Подробнее», чтобы изучить автом: Click Details to examine the car and its description. You can contact the seller from the listing. A low price may mean poor condition: check the details before buying.
messages.В обучении мы ничего не покупаем и не тр: The tutorial does not buy anything or spend your money.
messages.В переписке задавайте вопросы и предлага: Ask questions in chat and make an offer. The seller’s personality and mood affect negotiation. When you agree on a price, arrange a meeting.
messages.Это пример переписки. Настоящий диалог н: This is an example chat. Start a real conversation from a listing.
messages.В календаре появятся назначенные встречи: Your meetings appear in Calendar. Check the date, time and city, then head to the inspection. To visit another city, open Travel from the P menu.
messages.В игре время идёт быстрее реального. Пок: Game time runs faster than real time. It is paused during the tutorial.
messages.На встрече осмотрите автомобиль и провер: Inspect the car and check the terms at the meeting. Verify the price and vehicle details before signing. Money and the vehicle change hands after signing; the agreement is saved in Documents.
messages.Можно отказаться до подписания. В игре в: You can cancel before signing. Some cars have hidden faults or may be stolen.
messages.Купленная машина появится в гараже. Посм: Your purchased car appears in Garage. Check its condition and costs, prepare it for sale and post a listing. Profit is revenue minus the purchase price and other costs.
messages.Честно указывайте известные неисправност: Disclose known faults honestly: this affects your reputation and future deals.
messages.Кнопка ♪ в нижней панели включает и выкл: The ♪ button in the dock turns background music on or off. Your choice survives a restart. Try it here.
Music starts after you click. If there is no sound, check your device volume and browser sound permissions.
messages.Калькулятор поможет посчитать расходы. В: Use Calculator to work out costs. Clock shows game time and lets you sleep at night. Settings lets you change your nickname and signature and save a progress backup.
messages.Справка и повтор обучения всегда доступн: Help and the tutorial are always available from the P menu. Good luck with your first deal!
messages.Сначала закройте текущее диалоговое окно: Close the current dialog before opening the tutorial.
messages.Подпись — ровно 4 заглавные латинские бу: Your signature must be exactly 4 uppercase Latin letters.

messages.Ник сохранён. Подписанные договоры сохра: Nickname saved. Signed contracts keep their original details.
messages.Новая подпись сохранена для следующих до: Your new signature has been saved for future contracts.
messages.Сбросить игровой прогресс? Деньги, машин: Reset game progress? Money, cars, debts, meetings and contracts will be deleted. Your nickname, signature, appearance and music preference will be kept.
messages.Снять объявление и отклонить все предлож: Remove this listing and reject all offers?
Cancel the meeting? The deal will fall through.
messages.Отказаться от подписания? Автомобиль и д: Cancel signing? The vehicle and money will remain with their owners.
Change the filters or press Reset.
Choose a city from the list.
messages.Банк рассматривает заявку от 15 минут до: The bank reviews applications in 15 minutes to 3 game hours. Approval depends on the amount, assets, debts and a random decision.
messages.С пересадками при необходимости. Самый н: Transfers if needed. The least expensive public transport option.
messages.Дорога в аэропорт и регистрация включены: Airport transfers and check-in are included.
messages.Общественный транспорт перевозит только: Public transport carries only you. Your car stays where it is parked. After buying outside Moscow, you can drive the car home or book a car transporter in Garage.
messages.Здесь появятся ваши автомобили и их мест: Your vehicles and their locations will appear here.
messages.Одно место в Москве. Остальные машины —: One space in Moscow. Other cars stay in the free yard.
messages.Ближайших встреч нет. Договоритесь о цен: No upcoming meetings. Agree on a price and arrange a meeting in chat.
messages.Ваш путь в автобизнесе: Your journey in the car business
messages.Цель прохождения — открыть свой автосало: Your goal is to open your own dealership. You can continue in free play afterward.
messages.При покупке: 3% на угон с немедленным из: Each market purchase has a 3% chance of being stolen and immediately seized, and a 30% chance of a hidden mechanical fault. Buying five stolen cars ends the game.
messages.Результат — сумма прибыли и убытков по п: The result totals sales profits and losses, including vehicle costs and settled claims. Loans, garages and other business expenses are excluded.
messages.После уровня «Автобизнес» можно заключит: At the Car Business level, hire a sourcing assistant for ₽30,000. Responses arrive 25% faster. You still handle purchases and signing.
messages.Откройте карточку машины и изучите истор: Open a vehicle listing and read its history.
messages.Напишите продавцу и согласуйте цену и вс: Contact the seller and agree on a price and meeting.
Attend the meeting and sign the purchase agreement.
messages.В гараже выставьте машину на продажу, ук: List the car for sale in Garage, disclosing all known faults.
messages.Договоритесь с покупателем и подпишите Д: Negotiate with a buyer and sign the sale agreement.
messages.Сохраняются последние 100 подписанных до: The last 100 signed contracts are stored here. A draft remains in the current meeting.
messages.Здесь появятся ваши подписанные договоры: Your signed agreements appear here after buying or selling a vehicle.
